ry_nxld2eDtIwr5zilOlCQ.zh: 法屬圭亞那於今年1月下旬報告自2014年以來首次發生本土病例,截至3/22累計65例確診病例,近期仍持續有病例發生,其中88%分布於西部沿海地區。 蘇利南自今年1月宣布爆發疫情以來,病例數明顯上升,已逾1,357例檢驗陽性及1例死亡,病例分布於該國8個行政區。當局表示病例數低估,並預期疫情可能隨著雨季到來而上升。
ry_nxld2eDtIwr5zilOlCQ.en: French Guiana reported its first locally acquired cases since 2014 in late January this year. As of 22 March, 65 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, and cases continue to occur; 88% are distributed along the western coast. Suriname has seen a marked rise in cases since it declared an outbreak in January this year, with more than 1,357 test-positive cases and 1 death reported, distributed across eight administrative districts. Authorities say case numbers are underestimated and expect the outbreak may rise with the arrival of the rainy season.

m9IF9Lp8K8FKKy-8jY_ONg.zh: 聖露西亞報告自2021年以來首例確診病例,該患者住院4天並接受支持性照護後,已完全康復,目前國內尚未發現其他病例。美洲包括古巴、法屬圭亞那、蓋亞那及蘇利南等地疫情持續,不同地區間人口流動且當地存在病媒蚊,造成該國仍有病例發生風險。
m9IF9Lp8K8FKKy-8jY_ONg.en: Saint Lucia has reported its first confirmed case since 2021. The patient was hospitalized for 4 days, received supportive care and has fully recovered; no other cases have been found in the country so far. Outbreaks continue in the Americas, including Cuba, French Guiana, Guyana and Suriname. Population movement between different areas, together with the presence of vector mosquitoes, means the country still faces a risk of cases.

1RpUyy5NiNuqOnzMR8MVaA.zh: 蘇利南疫情更新,於去年底報告自2016年以來首例本土病例,迄今年1月底累計712例疑病例(327例確診)及1例死亡,以北部巴拉馬利波區之確診病例數為多。 玻利維亞發生疫情,該國今年1-5週累計報告1,534例病例,其中以東部聖克魯斯省1,409例最多,該省近1週另新增1,515例病例,截至2月中已累計報告3,004例。該國去年累計報告近7,000例病例及4例死亡,美國CDC近期提升該國疫情旅遊警示至第2級。 古巴疫情持續,今年1月累計報告1,457例病例(114例確診)及2例死亡,去年累計報告51,217例病例(近2,000例確診)及46例死亡。
1RpUyy5NiNuqOnzMR8MVaA.en: Suriname's epidemic update: at the end of last year, the first locally acquired case since 2016 was reported. As of the end of January this year, 712 suspected cases (327 confirmed) and 1 death have been reported cumulatively, with the most confirmed cases in Paramaribo District in the north. Bolivia's outbreak continues: in weeks 1–5 this year, 1,534 cases were reported cumulatively, of which 1,409 were in the eastern Santa Cruz Department, the most of any area. In the past week, that department added a further 1,515 cases, and 3,004 cases had been reported cumulatively by mid-February. Last year Bolivia reported nearly 7,000 cases and 4 deaths, and the US CDC recently raised its travel notice for the country to Level 2. Cuba's outbreak continues: 1,457 cases (114 confirmed) and 2 deaths were reported cumulatively in January this year; last year, 51,217 cases (nearly 2,000 confirmed) and 46 deaths were reported cumulatively.

MCFQX-nUYICA4vbIj0-rrQ.zh: 泛美衛生組織(PAHO)於2/11發布警報,對於美洲數國自去年底迄今年初之疫情上升,建議各國加強監測、臨床及病媒蚊管制。全球去年1/1-12/10共41國/地區累計報告502,264例病例(208,335例確診)及186例死亡,其中,美洲報告313,132例病例(113,926例確診)及170例死亡,多國/地區自去年底疫情持續上升,且於近年無疫情發生之地區再次出現本地傳播病例,如蓋亞那、法屬圭亞那及蘇利南等國。
MCFQX-nUYICA4vbIj0-rrQ.en: The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) issued an alert on 11 February about rising outbreaks in several countries in the Americas since late last year and early this year, recommending strengthened surveillance, clinical management and vector mosquito control. Globally, from 1 January to 10 December last year, 41 countries and regions reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. Of these, the Americas reported 313,132 cases (113,926 confirmed) and 170 deaths. Many countries have seen outbreaks continue to rise since late last year, and locally transmitted cases have reappeared in areas without outbreaks in recent years, such as Guyana, French Guiana and Suriname.

xG79CRPRwknlxzv7O-AQYQ.zh: 蘇利南疫情持續,1月份累計報告137例病例,美國CDC近期提升該國疫情旅遊警示至第2級。 哥斯大黎加報告今年第2例確診病例,為該國西部旁塔雷納斯省埃斯帕爾薩郡51歲女性,依症狀出現日期評估,個案感染日期可能與首例病例相近。
xG79CRPRwknlxzv7O-AQYQ.en: Suriname's outbreak continues: 137 cases were reported in January, and the US CDC recently raised its travel notice for the country to Level 2. Costa Rica reported its second confirmed case this year, a 51-year-old woman from Esparza District in Puntarenas Province in the west of the country. Based on the date of symptom onset, the infection date may be close to that of the first case.

LpUDgkb0MtG4iyWDrc5bEw.zh: 哥斯大黎加報告自2017年以來首例病例,為該國西部旁塔雷納斯省24歲男性居民,當局積極進行流行病學監測及病媒蚊控制,預防疾病傳播。outbreaknewstoday 1/25 蘇利南發生疫情,已報告8例病例,皆無國外旅遊史,目前正進行接觸者追蹤調查,並加強監測措施,避免疫情擴散。outbreaknewstoday 1/23 巴西西部馬托羅索州之盧卡斯市(Lucas do Rio Verde),於2025年報告1,769例病例(808例陽性),明顯高於2024年11例報告病例(9例陽性),並發現當地大部分埃及斑蚊孳生地都於住宅內,當局對此已採取相關防治措施。
LpUDgkb0MtG4iyWDrc5bEw.en: Costa Rica reported its first case since 2017: a 24-year-old male resident of Puntarenas province in the west. Authorities are carrying out active epidemiological surveillance and vector mosquito control to prevent transmission (source: Outbreak News Today, 25 January). Suriname has an outbreak with 8 reported cases, none with recent travel abroad. Contact tracing is under way, and surveillance has been strengthened to prevent spread (Outbreak News Today, 23 January). In Lucas do Rio Verde in Mato Grosso state, western Brazil, 1,769 cases (808 positive) were reported in 2025, markedly higher than the 11 cases (9 positive) reported in 2024. Most local Aedes aegypti breeding sites were found inside homes, and authorities have taken control measures.
